SELECT sp.id AS sourceProductId, sp.source_product_name AS title, sp.source_product_url AS sourceUrl, sp.source_status AS sourceStatus, MIN(sku.stock) AS minStock, COUNT(*) AS lowSpecCount, h.handle_type AS handleType, DATE_FORMAT(h.handle_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS handleTime FROM source_sku sku JOIN source_product sp ON sp.id = sku.source_product_id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN low_stock_handle h ON h.source_product_id = sp.id WHERE sku.is_deleted = 0 AND sku.stock IS NOT NULL AND sku.stock < #{threshold} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM taobao_offer_map tm WHERE tm.source_product_id = sp.id )
AND h.source_product_id IS NULL
AND h.source_product_id IS NOT NULL
AND sp.source_product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY sp.id, sp.source_product_name, sp.source_product_url, sp.source_status, h.handle_type, h.handle_time ORDER BY minStock ASC, sp.id ASC
SELECT m.source_product_id AS sourceProductId, m.taobao_item_id AS taobaoItemId, m.offer_id AS offerId FROM taobao_offer_map m WHERE m.source_product_id IN #{id} ORDER BY m.taobao_item_id

SELECT sku.source_product_id AS sourceProductId, sku.sku_key AS skuKey, sku.stock AS stock, sku.price AS price FROM source_sku sku WHERE sku.is_deleted = 0 AND sku.stock IS NOT NULL AND sku.stock < #{threshold} AND sku.source_product_id IN #{id} ORDER BY sku.stock ASC, sku.sku_key ASC

SELECT sp.id AS sourceProductId, sp.source_product_name AS title, sp.source_product_url AS sourceUrl, sp.source_status AS sourceStatus, 0 AS lowSpecCount, h.handle_type AS handleType, DATE_FORMAT(h.handle_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS handleTime FROM source_product sp LEFT JOIN low_stock_handle h ON h.source_product_id = sp.id WHERE sp.is_deleted = 0 AND sp.source_status = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM taobao_offer_map tm WHERE tm.source_product_id = sp.id )
AND h.source_product_id IS NULL
AND h.source_product_id IS NOT NULL
AND sp.source_product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY sp.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO low_stock_handle (source_product_id, handle_type, handle_by, handle_time, update_time) VALUES (#{sourceProductId}, #{handleType}, #{handleBy}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE handle_type = VALUES(handle_type), handle_by = VALUES(handle_by), handle_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW()
